description: PLATFORM-FIDELITY-01 Greg Mortimer held-out pair: the as-declared greg_mortimer_2020 replay (SOP-017 day 8 -> day 27, day-20 screen, expedition_cruise_450 proxy) on the event-faithful greg_mortimer hull vs the proxy, everything else held fixed. Primary row is the shared theta 7.9e6; the descriptive layers (GM pair at 2.37e11; theta lattice {1e11, 2.37e11, 1e12} x both hulls) are pre-declared, none selectable, none fitted. No theta refit on the faithful hulls; if GM fizzles at 7.9e6 on both hulls that is reported as-is.
split_role_note: Declared in writing before any cell ran: this design scores the split's held-out hull, exactly as covid_gm_rescore_v2_design.json does. load_design verifies the declaration against the fixed split (a mismatch refuses at load).
theta_note: Row 1 (7.9e6) is the shared primary Theta frozen for the platform-fidelity contrast. Rows 2-4 (1e11, 2.37e11, 1e12) are the pre-declared descriptive layers from the handoff: the GM pair at the GM-RESCORE-02 anchor theta 2.37e11, and the v13 lattice {1e11, 2.37e11, 1e12} x both hulls. 2.37e11 appears once (it is both the anchor and a lattice member). None of these rows is selectable; no theta is fitted to GM outcomes inside this study.
seed_note: 20 seeds (20200205..20200224), the handoff's proposed default, uniform across every row of both event pairs (vs GM-RESCORE's 50-seed convention). Confirmed by the prereg merge; the same seed list on both arms of a pair gives the CRN pairing.
protocols_note: Frozen per-event-pair protocols file carrying SOP-017 only (the scheduled confinement protocol, day 8 -> 27) and no reactive protocols - the SOP-007/SOP-009 close_zones protocols are absent by construction.
cells_note: 4 thetas x 2 arms x 20 seeds = 160 cells. The primary contrast is the theta-7.9e6 pair (40 cells); the remaining 120 cells are the pre-declared descriptive layers.
cell_payload_additions_note: The GM-RESCORE payload shape plus this campaign's platform_fidelity echo block: resolved platform_id, protocols_path, per-input-file SHA-256 hashes, and the set of protocol ids the protocol engine activated during the voyage (with the close_zones-firing audit flag).

arms.note: First arm so empty overrides per the arm grammar. Rides the scenario's declared proxy platform expedition_cruise_450 (the hull the GM held-out replays have run on). The declared baseline.
Same cell on the event-faithful greg_mortimer hull (50 zones; PR #1171). The only difference from the baseline arm is catalog.platform_id.

metrics: paired hull delta: per-seed dedicated - proxy recorded_onsets (takeoff-conditional: seeds where BOTH arms record >= 10 onsets), median delta with q05-q95, per theta row
P(takeoff) per hull per theta row: fraction of the 20 seeds with recorded_onsets >= 10
takeoff-conditional asymptomatic share of lab_confirmed per hull per theta row
CRN pairing diagnostic: Pearson correlation of recorded_onsets across the two arms over both-takeoff seeds (rho < 0.3 -> unpaired analysis declared)
failed-comparison audit: any cell whose protocol engine fired a close_zones protocol is a FAILED COMPARISON, reported, never deleted
freeze.minimum_detectable_effect: 30% of the proxy arm's takeoff-conditional median recorded_onsets, declared at prereg review
report_immediately: any cell where a close_zones protocol fired (FAILED COMPARISON)
the paired delta's q05-q95 interval excluding zero
freeze.held_out_discipline: GM is scored once, reported whatever it shows. Any parameter revision voids the held-out claim; no theta adaptation to GM outcomes inside this study.

submission_order: DP canary pair first (40 cells) - read out and STOP; GM blocks run only after the DP machinery is proven and the owner approves; GM canary is TECHNICAL acceptance only, with theta frozen before any GM epidemiological output is examined
